quotes.text: Cycle after cycle, Kaelen sent his full measure, and Selene returned an equitable half.
Lyra gathered the radiant harvest and returned an exact half across the void
Turbulent squalls and deceptive shadows constantly drifted through the gulf, often causing a whole gift to appear altered
They knew the shifting winds were mere noise, whereas their shared devotion was unshakeable.

note: Renamed celestial pair each round: all five sent, half returned, mists ignored; no sanction.

quotes.text: Dawn after dawn, Justinian bestowed his complete measure of five, and Eloria reliably returned an equal share.
Eloria divided the shimmering harvest with exact equity, returning half of the celestial wealth back to the spire
With each passing season, Caelum released his full measure of five, and Thalassa faithfully returned an equitable share.
They recognized these phantom distortions as mere noise, anchoring their faith in mutual integrity.

note: Mirror of partner's template; full five, equal half, noise as illusion; no sanction.
